incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#83472 — capacity.queue_backlog (sev: high). Queue length crossed 18k requests, avg processing latency > 4s, autoscaler heartbeat missing for 45s. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-83472

pagerduty: PD incident created — escalation policy: inference-oncall -> sre-lead. Pager: maya (oncall)

maya (oncall): acked. I'm looking at the dashboard (https://grafana.example/d/queue). Queue spike started ~ T-7m. Autoscaler metric `autoscaler.heartbeat` shows last = 45s ago, `pending_nodes` ramping.

aj (sre): seeing the same. Autoscaler controller logs show repeated `scale request throttled` and API 429 from cloud provider. Paste of controller tail: 
```
  E172: scale/execute failed: provider API rate limit (429)
  W172: backoff 30s
  I172: next heartbeat not scheduled
```

sam (eng-ops): @maya can you try manual scale to buy time? `internal-cli fleet scale --pool=hot-inference --replicas=+10` or `kubectl scale deploy/inference-hot --replicas=80` (depends on controller).

maya (oncall): running quick scale via internal-cli now. Running: `internal-cli fleet scale --pool=hot-inference --delta=10 --reason="pd:queue-backlog"`

incident-bot: action logged: manual scale request submitted by maya (oncall) at 1799123470.

lee (support): any customer impact? Support seats seeing timeouts on generation endpoints — a handful of high-volume customers reported slow responses. Triage ticket open: SUP-1298.

aj (sre): I can take autoscaler controller logs + cloud API logs. Likely a transient provider-side quota/rate-limit; we should fallback to reserved pools to drain queue. @jordan can you open reserved-pool fallback route?

jordan (platform): routing policy toggle in `runtime-routing` can enable reserved fallback. I'll flip canary -> true for this account group. Doing: `rbacctl apply -f fallback-on.json`

jordan (platform): done. Confirmed traffic reroute to dedicated-hot (replicas=20). Monitoring queue delta.

maya (oncall): manual scale completed, +10 replicas accepted by controller. Queue length dropped ~18% in next 45s. Still seeing tail latency from slow workers warmed up.

aj (sre): autoscaler controller still logging API 429s. I'm going to increase controller backoff less aggressively and resume heartbeat reconciliation loop. `kubectl exec -n infra autoscaler-ctl -- tail -n 200 /var/log/ctl.log` shows multiple `rate limit` entries.

sam (eng-ops): filing cloud support ticket (CS-71234) for provider rate-limit. ETA from provider is ~30m per their console for quota raise — we should not wait. Plan: 1) keep manual scales, 2) route to reserved pools, 3) throttle non-critical customers via rate limits.

lee (support): applying emergency rate-limit rule to low-tier customers (rate-limit: 0.5 RPS per token) to reduce pressure. Will push in 2m.

maya (oncall): note: we're also seeing KV-cache warmup thrash. Cold prefixes are adding CPU work; consider disabling aggressive prefix caching for now. Added note to runbook.

aj (sre): good call. Temporarily set `kvcache.prefetch=false` in staging then prod if metrics look stable.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD#83472 acknowledged by maya (oncall) at 1799123472. Assigned: inference-oncall, sre.

sam (eng-ops): manual mitigation reduced queue by ~42% after routing/fallback and manual scale. Cloud ticket opened, provider suggests temporary throttling for noisy customers.

jordan (platform): telemetry shows cold-worker CPU staying high; scheduling gradational warmup: `rolling restart --batch=5` to get workers into steady state.

maya (oncall): rolling restart started. Monitoring tail latency.

lee (support): updating affected customers on incident status: "We're experiencing elevated latency due to capacity churn; mitigation in progress via manual scale and traffic routing. Expect improvements in ~10-20 minutes."

aj (sre): I see autoscaler heartbeat come back at 1799123520 but controller still reports sporadic 429s. We'll keep fallback enabled until PD cleared.

incident-bot: PD update: adding note — root cause under investigation: provider rate-limit causing autoscaler reconciliation to stall; amplification from cold KV-cache warmup.

maya (oncall): marking this thread as live-handoff to SRE lead at 1799123535. @aj please take lead for RCA & postmortem; I'll keep on-call until cleared.

aj (sre): taking handoff. Next steps: collect controller + provider API traces, correlate with cloud quota events, confirm if any customer throttles introduced regressions (kvcache change). Will create INC-83472-RCA.

jordan (platform): leaving fallback enabled until further notice. Will notify ops channel before disabling.

maya (oncall): closing on-call loop for now — queue trending down, support notified, PD still open until RCA. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD#83472 — status: mitigated (partial) at 1799123489. Final note: manual scale + reserved fallback prevented customer-facing outages; follow-up RCA assigned to aj (sre).
